snippet.title: Colossus: Eternal Blight - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1722800/Colossus__Eternal_Blight/

Colossus: Eternal Blight is Hyper Light Drifter meets Chrono Trigger and Trials of Mana! Embark on an epic adventure as Lucian, a young knight determined to save his older brother Lance from the corruption that has overtaken him. Traverse through different cities and towns of the kingdom, encountering various manifestations of corruption along the way. 

Utilize Lucian's combat skills and the power of the sacred stones to purify the corrupted creatures and overcome the challenges that await. Will you be able to save Lance from the corruption that has consumed him? The fate of the kingdom rests in your hands in this emotional and action-packed RPG.

Meet the Dev (RUSTIC PANDA GAMES)
Website: https://www.rusticpandagames.com/
X: https://x.com/Rustic_Panda
